pins.headline: A weight loss tracker you’ll actually use
pins.sub: 10-second check-ins, a real trend line and gentle wins.
pins.title: Weight Loss Tracker App for Your Phone: 10-Second Daily Check-In, No Subscription
pins.description: Looking for a weight loss tracker that's quick and kind? Check in with your weight, water and mood in about 10 seconds, then watch your smooth trend line go down. Includes a weight loss journal, body measurements, before-and-after photos, calorie or simple food logging, habits and milestone badges. Works on iPhone, Android and computer, offline and private.
pins.alt: Three phones showing a coral weight loss tracker app: a weight trend chart, a Today screen with a goal ring and streak, and a food log with a calorie ring.

pins.headline: Scale went up? Check your trend
pins.sub: Day-to-day jumps are mostly water. The trend is the truth.
pins.title: Why the Scale Went Up Overnight (and Why Your Weight Loss Trend Matters More)
pins.description: Gained 2 pounds overnight? It's usually water, salt or timing, not fat. A weight loss trend line smooths out daily swings so you can see real progress. This tracker app shows your trend weight, weekly pace and projected goal date, and its plateau decoder tells you when the scale is up but your trend is still going down.
pins.alt: A phone showing a weight trend chart with daily scale dots and a smooth trend line, above a pink card titled Plateau decoder.

pins.headline: 5 habits that make weight loss stick
bullets: Weigh in at the same time each morning
Watch the weekly trend, not the day
pins.title: 5 Healthy Habits That Make Weight Loss Stick (Simple Tips for Beginners)
pins.description: Small habits beat big plans. Weigh in at the same time each morning, watch your weekly trend instead of the daily number, get protein at every meal, drink water before snacks and celebrate non-scale victories. This weight loss tracker app helps with all five: a 10-second check-in, a trend line, protein tracking, a water tracker and a wins log.
pins.alt: A checklist of five weight loss habits above a phone showing a weight loss tracker's Today screen.

pins.headline: See your before and after
pins.sub: Progress photos and inches lost, side by side.
pins.title: Before and After Weight Loss Progress Photos + Body Measurement Tracker
pins.description: Sometimes the scale barely moves while your body changes. Track progress photos with a drag-to-compare before-and-after slider, and log waist, hips, chest, thigh, arm and neck measurements to see total inches lost. Photos stay private on your own device. Part of a complete weight loss tracker app with a journal, habits and milestones.
pins.alt: Two phones: one with a before-and-after photo slider, one listing body measurements with inches lost per area.

pins.headline: Track food without counting calories
pins.sub: Rate each meal Great, Okay or Treat. No guilt.
pins.title: How to Track Food Without Counting Calories: A Simple, No-Guilt Food Diary
pins.description: Burned out on calorie counting? Try rating each meal instead: Great, Okay or Treat. It builds awareness without the math or the guilt. This weight loss tracker app has a Simple mode for exactly that, plus an optional calorie and protein counter, quick re-add for favorite meals and a water tracker you tap to fill.
pins.alt: A phone showing a food log in Simple mode with counts of Great, Okay and Treat meals.
